_rules: Kinds of mark for wf design annotate. Never change or remove one, or reuse its colour: the same kind looks the same in every run and every project. A project adds its own under design.kinds in .workflow/config.json; a kind every project needs is added here, at the end, with its line in the test.

look.use: Where a question asks Ken to look.

bug.use: Something broken: a fault, a crash, or wrong behaviour.

drift.use: A difference between a frame, a story, and the app.

ok.use: Checked and right, shown for contrast.

new.use: What is new or changed in a picture sent for review, such as a redrawn frame.
